items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: The Tulane Band. That was Amos Raleigh. He was a corn-ed player.

ctx.x: Chicago girl now. See? See that? Is there anything about Roy Palmer that you can tell us?

Well, Roy Palmer, he was playing with, when I first got him, he was playing with Amos Raleigh. You know who I talk about Amos Raleigh? Yes. A corn-ed player. Well, he used to be with that, I believe if I'm mistaken, it was the Tulane Band. The Tulane Band. That was Amos Raleigh. He was a corn-ed player. Well, Amos, this fellow used to play with him. And, uh, this other fellow, what's the name again? He used to play tram on wood, him. And then he started going, he went to wood too. Well, I found it out and I don't…
No, he's still living. I saw him last year.
